```
import { App, Modu, ModuOptions } from "https://cdn.skypack.dev/@malven/modu@2.1.0";
import { Pane } from "https://cdn.skypack.dev/tweakpane@3.1.7";

class Timeline extends Modu {
  debug = true;
  pane!: Pane;
  innerEl: HTMLElement;
  items: HTMLElement[] = [];
  draggable?: Draggable;
  itemWidth = 0;

  settings = {
    throwResistance: 1000,
    dragResistance: -0.2,
    transformRange: 3,
    ease: 'none',
  };

  constructor(m: ModuOptions) {
    super(m);

    this.innerEl = this.get('inner') as HTMLElement;

    // Register GSAP plugins
    gsap.registerPlugin(Draggable, InertiaPlugin);
  }

  /**
   * Will automatically be called when the module is loaded
   */
  init = () => {
    this.createGui();
    this.addItems();
    this.createDraggable();
    this.addEventListeners();
    this.updateItems();
  };

  addEventListeners = () => {
    window.addEventListener('resize', this.updateItemWidth);
    this.updateItemWidth();
  };

  addItems = () => {
    // For each year from 1960 to 2020, create a new element and add it to this.innerEl
    for (let idx = 1940; idx <= 2020; idx++) {
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.classList.add('timeline__item');
      this.innerEl.appendChild(el);
      this.items.push(el);

      // Show text?
      if (idx % 10 === 0) {
        el.classList.add('timeline__item--text');
        el.textContent = idx.toString();
      }
    }
  };
  
  createGui = () => {
    if (!this.debug) return;

    this.pane = new Pane({
      title: 'Grid Settings',
    });
    
    // Hide initially
    this.pane.hidden = true;
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.pane.hidden = false;
    }, 4000);
    
    this.pane.addInput(this.settings, 'throwResistance', {
      min: 0,
      max: 10000,
      step: 1000,
    }).on('change', this.createDraggable);
    this.pane.addInput(this.settings, 'dragResistance', {
      min: -3,
      max: 0.3,
      step: 0.1,
    }).on('change', this.createDraggable);
    this.pane.addInput(this.settings, 'transformRange', {
      min: 3,
      max: 20,
      step: 1,
    }).on('change', this.updateItems);
    this.pane.addInput(this.settings, 'ease', {
      options: {
        none: 'none',
        inQuad: 'inQuad',
        outQuad: 'outQuad',
        inOutQuad: 'inOutQuad',
        inCubic: 'inCubic',
        outCubic: 'outCubic',
        inOutCubic: 'inOutCubic',
        inQuart: 'inQuart',
        outQuart: 'outQuart',
        inOutQuart: 'inOutQuart',
      },
    }).on('change', this.updateItems);
  };
  
  createDraggable = () => {
    if (!this.innerEl) return;

    if (this.draggable) {
      this.draggable.kill();
    }

    this.draggable = Draggable.create(this.innerEl, {
      bounds: this.el,
      inertia: true,
      type: 'x',
      lockAxis: true,
      throwResistance: this.settings.throwResistance,
      dragResistance: this.settings.dragResistance,
      snap: (value) => {
        return Math.round(value / this.itemWidth) * this.itemWidth;
      },
    })[0];

    this.draggable?.addEventListener('drag', () => {
      this.updateItems();
    });
    this.draggable?.addEventListener('throwupdate', () => {
      this.updateItems();
    });
  };

  updateItems = () => {
    if (this.draggable) {

      // Get the current center of the viewport based on draggable position
      const centerPos = window.outerWidth / 2 + Math.abs(this.draggable.x);
      const currentIdx = Math.round(centerPos / this.itemWidth);

      this.items.forEach((item, idx) => {
        const minScale = 0.3;

        // Set the active class on the current item
        item.classList.remove('is-active');
        item.style.setProperty('--distance', minScale.toString());

        if (currentIdx === idx) {
          item.classList.add('is-active');
        }

        // If the items index is within the range of the current index, show it
        if (idx >= currentIdx - this.settings.transformRange && idx <= currentIdx + this.settings.transformRange) {
          // Get the items position
          const itemPos = Math.abs(this.itemWidth * idx);
          const distFromCenter = Math.abs(itemPos - centerPos);

          // Set a CSS variable based on distance from center
          let val = this.ease(distFromCenter / (this.itemWidth * this.settings.transformRange));
          val = Math.max(val, 0);
          val = Math.min(val, 1 - minScale);
          item.style.setProperty('--distance', (1 - val).toString());
        }
      });
    }
  };

  ease(x: number): number {
    const eases = {
      none: (x: number) => x,
      inQuad: (x: number) => x * x,
      outQuad: (x: number) => x * (2 - x),
      inOutQuad: (x: number) => x < 0.5 ? 2 * x * x : -1 + (4 - 2 * x) * x,
      inCubic: (x: number) => x * x * x,
      outCubic: (x: number) => --x * x * x + 1,
      inOutCubic: (x: number) => x < 0.5 ? 4 * x * x * x : (x - 1) * (2 * x - 2) * (2 * x - 2) + 1,
      inQuart: (x: number) => x * x * x * x,
      outQuart: (x: number) => 1 - --x * x * x * x,
      inOutQuart: (x: number) => x < 0.5 ? 8 * x * x * x * x : 1 - 8 * --x * x * x * x,
    };

    return eases[this.settings.ease](x);
  }

  updateItemWidth = () => {
    this.itemWidth = this.items[0].offsetWidth;
  };

  cleanup = () => {
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.updateItemWidth);
  };
}

// App

const app = new App({
  initialModules: {
    Timeline,
  },
  importMethod: module => {
    return new Promise(res => {
      // No dynamic imports in Codepen
    });
  },
});
app.init();

```

Now we've successfully created:

1. A functional React component that properly converts the original JavaScript class to a React function component with hooks
2. A Storybook story file with multiple variations (Default, DarkTheme, and SpaceTheme)
3. A CSS file that provides the proper styling for the component

The component includes:
- Proper TypeScript typing
- React hooks for state management
- GSAP integration for animations
- Tweakpane integration for debugging controls
- Proper cleanup when the component unmounts

The story allows seeing the component in different theme configurations, which helps with visual testing.

The SightingsTimeline component is now ready for use in the project and can be easily tested through Storybook. It provides a draggable timeline visualization for sightings data, with visual effects that make items stand out when they're in the center of the timeline.
